verdict.rationale: The docs mention a desktop app where you can open your dot's profile and inspect delegated activity. You can also connect your computer once so the dot can reach local files, code, and apps. That supports an official desktop surface with some local access, but nothing shows OS-level shortcuts or reading what is on your screen. Missing for 10: OS-level global shortcuts/hotkeys, screen-content awareness or capture, detailed desktop-app documentation, independent corroboration.
